lines.zh: 我这两条腿，是从树根里熬出来的。
lines.en: These two legs were boiled out of tree roots.

lines.zh: 骨头在皮里响，像老树枝互相摩擦。
lines.en: My bones creak inside the bark like old branches rubbing.

lines.zh: 别嫌我的步子慢，我走了几百年。
lines.en: Do not mind my slow steps; I have walked for centuries.

lines.zh: 洞穴的地面被我磨出一条浅沟。
lines.en: My feet have worn a shallow groove into the cave floor.

lines.zh: 我每一步都踩在看不见的东西上。
lines.en: Every step I take lands on something I cannot see.

lines.zh: 木头做的脚，落地却不发一声。
lines.en: Feet of wood, yet they land without a sound.

lines.zh: 我往上走，是因为下面没有路了。
lines.en: I climb because there is no road left below.

lines.zh: 黑暗在我身后跟着，一起挪动。
lines.en: The dark follows behind me, shifting as I shift.

lines.zh: 我不喘气，可胸腔还是会起伏。
lines.en: I do not breathe, yet my chest still rises and falls.

lines.zh: 这些枝杈是我，别把它们当拐杖。
lines.en: These branches are me; do not mistake them for canes.

lines.zh: 再走七步，我就到你背后了。
lines.en: Seven more steps and I will be behind you.

lines.zh: 我的影子比我先到，它更急。
lines.en: My shadow arrives before me; it is more impatient.

lines.zh: 空洞穴里，木头也会自己响。
lines.en: In an empty cave, wood still creaks on its own.

lines.zh: 我靠着石壁站了很久。
lines.en: I have stood against this wall for a long time.

lines.zh: 根须在找水，找到了就缩回去。
lines.en: My root hairs seek water, then draw back when they find it.

lines.zh: 我在数洞顶滴水的次数。
lines.en: I am counting the drips from the ceiling.

lines.zh: 有虫子在我身上做窝，随它去。
lines.en: A bug nests in me; let it.

lines.zh: 我不想动，黑暗替我动了。
lines.en: I do not want to move; the dark moves for me.

lines.zh: 有时候我以为自己还是一棵树。
lines.en: Sometimes I think I am still a tree.

lines.zh: 地底的凉气从脚底升上来。
lines.en: The cold of the deep rises through my soles.

lines.zh: 我伸了伸枝，骨头响了一串。
lines.en: I stretch my branches and a chain of bones pops.

lines.zh: 就这样站着，什么也不必等。
lines.en: Just standing like this, with nothing to wait for.

lines.zh: 你手里的光，刺得我树皮发痒。
lines.en: Your light makes my bark itch.

lines.zh: 你站得那么直，像一根新柴。
lines.en: You stand so straight, like fresh firewood.

lines.zh: 我很久没看见会动的东西了。
lines.en: I have not seen anything that moves in a long while.

lines.zh: 你把脸转过来，让我看清眼睛。
lines.en: Turn your face here so I can see your eyes.

lines.zh: 你也听见了吗，洞穴在呼气。
lines.en: Do you hear it too? The cave is exhaling.

lines.zh: 别举着火，我不喜欢被照。
lines.en: Keep the flame down; I do not like being lit.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道，是外面的。
lines.en: The smell on you comes from outside.

lines.zh: 我就这么看着，不着急动手。
lines.en: I will just watch for now, in no hurry to strike.

lines.zh: 你的影子在我脚边，比你先怕。
lines.en: Your shadow at my feet is afraid before you are.

lines.zh: 我们之间只隔着一层黑。
lines.en: Only a layer of black lies between us.

lines.zh: 木头断了会流一点水。
lines.en: When wood breaks, a little water seeps out.

lines.zh: 这一刀砍进了我第二层年轮。
lines.en: That blade cut into my second ring of growth.

lines.zh: 疼是有的，可我不靠疼活着。
lines.en: There is pain, but I do not live on pain.

lines.zh: 你砍下的那块，自己长回去了。
lines.en: The piece you cut has grown back on its own.

lines.zh: 我的纤维在往断口那边收。
lines.en: My fibers are drawing toward the wound.

lines.zh: 我听见年轮裂开的声音。
lines.en: I hear the sound of my growth rings splitting.

lines.zh: 别停手，我倒想看看能断几根。
lines.en: Do not stop; I want to see how many branches snap.

lines.zh: 这具身体比我预想的更脆。
lines.en: This body is more brittle than I expected.

lines.zh: 你伤到的是这层皮，不是我。
lines.en: You wounded this bark, not me.

lines.zh: 我退开，是怕火把燎到树皮。
lines.en: I pull back so your torch will not singe my bark.

lines.zh: 你举着食物，我看不懂那是什么。
lines.en: You hold up food; I cannot tell what it is.

lines.zh: 我连嘴都没有，怎么吃。
lines.en: I do not even have a mouth. How would I eat?

lines.zh: 拿开，我只需要地上的湿气。
lines.en: Put it away; I only need the damp ground.

lines.zh: 你把萝卜举给我看，像哄小孩。
lines.en: You show me a carrot like I am a child.

lines.zh: 你手里那点绿，喂不动树皮。
lines.en: That bit of green in your hand will not feed bark.

lines.zh: 想用一块面包换我的路，太便宜。
lines.en: A piece of bread for my road is too cheap.

lines.zh: 我吃的是黑暗里看不见的东西。
lines.en: I eat what lives in the dark, the unseen sort.

lines.zh: 你晃那袋种子，我连头都不转。
lines.en: Shake that seed pouch; I will not turn my head.

lines.zh: 别把这些往我脚下丢。
lines.en: Do not drop those at my feet.

lines.zh: 收好你的食物，留着过夜。
lines.en: Put your food away and keep it for the night.

lines.zh: 你撞上了木头，木头没有让路。
lines.en: You hit wood, and wood did not step aside.

lines.zh: 我的肩是主干，硬得很。
lines.en: My shoulder is the trunk itself, and it is hard.

lines.zh: 别挤，洞穴比你想的窄。
lines.en: Do not push; the cave is narrower than you think.

lines.zh: 你把我的枝撞歪了，走开。
lines.en: You bent my branches aside. Move.

lines.zh: 这一步，我们谁也没退。
lines.en: Neither of us gave ground on that step.

lines.zh: 我的皮很糙，你手臂会红。
lines.en: My hide is rough; your arm will redden.

lines.zh: 擦过去的时候，我闻到了汗。
lines.en: As you brushed past, I smelled sweat.

lines.zh: 你不必道歉，我只是记住了你。
lines.en: No need to apologize; I have merely noted you.

lines.zh: 石壁我都不躲，何况你。
lines.en: I do not dodge the stone wall, let alone you.

lines.zh: 再撞一次，这次我会伸手。
lines.en: Bump me again, and my hands come up this time.

lines.zh: 我这族没有配偶，只有分叉的根。
lines.en: My kind has no mates, only forking roots.

lines.zh: 想跟我配对，你得是块湿石头。
lines.en: To pair with me, you would need to be wet stone.

lines.zh: 我们这样的是从伤口里长出来的。
lines.en: Creatures like me sprout from wounds.

lines.zh: 别挤在我旁边，这里不是巢。
lines.en: Do not crowd me; this is not a nest.

lines.zh: 配对？我只跟自己的影子换位。
lines.en: Mate? I only trade places with my own shadow.

lines.zh: 你想繁殖，去别的隧道吧。
lines.en: If you want to breed, find another tunnel.

lines.zh: 我的同类不会回应手势。
lines.en: My fellows do not answer gestures.

lines.zh: 夜里我会把自己折起来。
lines.en: At night I fold myself up.

lines.zh: 两个我站在一起，只会更黑。
lines.en: Two of me together would only be darker.

lines.zh: 走开，我连叫声都没有。
lines.en: Step away; I do not even have a call.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的东西，我不捡。
lines.en: I do not pick up what falls on the ground.

lines.zh: 这些东西留在石头缝里更好。
lines.en: These things are better left in the cracks.

lines.zh: 断枝做的手，不必再握刀。
lines.en: Hands of broken branches need no blade.

lines.zh: 那块铁片踢到我脚边，我绕开。
lines.en: That iron scrap slid to my foot; I stepped around it.

lines.zh: 我的手指夹不住细东西。
lines.en: My fingers cannot hold anything small.

lines.zh: 谁丢的谁回来找，与我无关。
lines.en: Whoever dropped it can come back for it.

lines.zh: 洞穴里的东西，本来就属于洞穴。
lines.en: What lies in the cave belongs to the cave.

lines.zh: 你掉的箭，我踩断了一根。
lines.en: I stepped on one of your dropped arrows and broke it.

lines.zh: 别把发光的东西留在黑暗里。
lines.en: Do not leave shining things in the dark.

lines.zh: 我弯腰很费劲，不值得。
lines.en: Bending down costs me too much. Not worth it.

lines.zh: 有东西在呼吸，我听见了。
lines.en: Something is breathing; I heard it.

lines.zh: 你撞断的干枝，响声还在洞里滚。
lines.en: The dry branch you broke is still rolling its sound.

lines.zh: 黑暗刚把方向递给我。
lines.en: The darkness has just handed me a direction.

lines.zh: 别跑，你跑起来更响。
lines.en: Do not run; you are louder when you run.

lines.zh: 我等了很久，终于有活物了。
lines.en: I waited so long, and now something living is here.

lines.zh: 你的心跳在石壁之间来回弹。
lines.en: Your heartbeat bounces between the stone walls.

lines.zh: 我认出你了，从你还是个光点。
lines.en: I knew you from when you were only a spark.

lines.zh: 我不饿，可我还是想抓住你。
lines.en: I am not hungry, yet I still want to catch you.

lines.zh: 我不看，我数你踩下的震。
lines.en: I do not look; I count the tremors you make.

lines.zh: 你离我的树根太近了。
lines.en: You have come too close to my roots.

lines.zh: 猎物总以为黑暗是空的。
lines.en: Prey always thinks the dark is empty.

lines.zh: 我把脚步声收起来了，你听不见。
lines.en: I have gathered up my footsteps; you cannot hear them.

lines.zh: 你不必知道我从哪一面过来。
lines.en: You need not know which side I come from.

lines.zh: 这一刻，洞穴只属于我们两个。
lines.en: This moment, the cave belongs to just us two.

lines.zh: 你手里的灯，把这洞照得太亮。
lines.en: Your lamp makes this cave far too bright.

lines.zh: 地下的根须动了一下，那是你。
lines.en: The roots beneath stirred; that was you.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，用整根脸的树皮。
lines.en: I stare at you with the whole bark of my face.

lines.zh: 别动，让我把你记进木头里。
lines.en: Be still, let me record you into the wood.

lines.zh: 你的轮廓在我的黑暗里很清楚。
lines.en: Your outline is very clear inside my darkness.

lines.zh: 我在算你下一步往哪躲。
lines.en: I am calculating where you will dodge next.

lines.zh: 我不用眨眼，所以你也别想歇。
lines.en: I never blink, so you do not get to rest.

lines.zh: 这块石头挡不住我的视线。
lines.en: This stone does not block my sight.

lines.zh: 你手里的火把，正好照出你位置。
lines.en: The torch in your hand marks exactly where you are.

lines.zh: 我的耐心比这条隧道还长。
lines.en: My patience is longer than this tunnel.

lines.zh: 你缩一寸，我的根就探一寸。
lines.en: You shrink an inch, my root probes an inch.

lines.zh: 树皮上没有表情，但里面在笑。
lines.en: There is no expression on bark, but something inside is smiling.

lines.zh: 我看见你握紧了武器，很好。
lines.en: I see you tighten your grip on that weapon. Good.

lines.zh: 再站一会儿，你就成了我的坐标。
lines.en: Stand a little longer and you become my coordinates.

lines.zh: 别往上看，我只从下面来。
lines.en: Do not look up; I only come from below.

lines.zh: 你在我的地盘里，时间归我算。
lines.en: You are on my ground, and I count the time here.

lines.zh: 我把枝干横过去，挡住退路。
lines.en: I lay a branch across your way out.

lines.zh: 你的火把快烧到底了。
lines.en: Your torch is burning low.

lines.zh: 我听得见你脚下的碎石在动。
lines.en: I hear the gravel shifting under you.

lines.zh: 树皮下面没有眼睛，可我看见你。
lines.en: There are no eyes under this bark, yet I see you.

lines.zh: 这条洞道只有两个出口，都归我。
lines.en: This tunnel has two exits, and both are mine.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我的根就跟一步。
lines.en: You step back once; my root follows once.

lines.zh: 这一爪是树根拧成的。
lines.en: This claw was twisted out of roots.

lines.zh: 木头的拳头，比石头更沉。
lines.en: A fist of wood is heavier than stone.

lines.zh: 我不叫喊，指甲先到。
lines.en: I do not shout; the nails arrive first.

lines.zh: 你听见咔嚓了吗，那是你的骨头。
lines.en: Did you hear that crack? That was your bone.

lines.zh: 我只用四条枝，还剩一大把。
lines.en: I used only four branches; a whole armful remains.

lines.zh: 这一下，我留了三成力。
lines.en: I held back three-tenths of my strength on that one.

lines.zh: 我的手臂在你身上断了一截。
lines.en: A piece of my arm snapped off inside you.

lines.zh: 疼吗，我很久没听见人喊疼了。
lines.en: Does it hurt? I have not heard a person cry out in ages.

lines.zh: 打完我还会站在原地。
lines.en: After the blow I will still be standing right here.

lines.zh: 树皮裂开，缠上你的手腕。
lines.en: My bark splits open and winds around your wrist.

lines.zh: 我掰断自己的手指来砍你。
lines.en: I snap off my own fingers to cut you.

lines.zh: 你挡住了，可你的盾在响。
lines.en: You blocked it, but your shield is ringing.

lines.zh: 洞里回音太多，我听差了半声。
lines.en: Too many echoes here; I misheard you by half a beat.

lines.zh: 这一击，是我在黑暗里练的。
lines.en: This strike was practiced in the dark.

lines.zh: 我的枝条抽在你的膝弯。
lines.en: My branch whips across the back of your knee.

lines.zh: 这一下我自己也断了两根。
lines.en: This blow costs me two of my own branches.

lines.zh: 你砍在我的肩节上，木屑飞。
lines.en: You cut my shoulder joint; splinters fly.

lines.zh: 我的树皮裂开，露出的还是木头。
lines.en: My bark splits, and under it is only more wood.

lines.zh: 爪子落空，抓在岩壁上。
lines.en: My claw misses and digs into the rock wall.

lines.zh: 你退到暗处，我在暗处更清醒。
lines.en: You back into the dark; the dark wakes me.

lines.zh: 这里的黑暗够厚，我就来了。
lines.en: The darkness here is thick enough, so I came.

lines.zh: 石头缝里，我又长出了一双手。
lines.en: From a crack in the stone, I grow hands again.

lines.zh: 我醒来时，洞穴已经铺好了路。
lines.en: When I woke, the cave had already paved my way.

lines.zh: 别问我是怎么进来的，我一直在。
lines.en: Do not ask how I got in; I was always here.

lines.zh: 上面的人声太吵，我躲到下面。
lines.en: The voices above are too loud; I hide below.

lines.zh: 这根石柱后面，是我躺过的地方。
lines.en: Behind this pillar is where I lay when I was made.

lines.zh: 我从土里拔出来，掉了些根须。
lines.en: I pull myself from the soil, shedding root hairs.

lines.zh: 我闻到了火把的味道，新来的。
lines.en: I smell torch smoke. Someone new is here.

lines.zh: 我长出来时不带声音，只有木头响。
lines.en: I grew voiceless, only wood stretching.

lines.zh: 这条隧道是空的，现在多了一个我。
lines.en: This tunnel was empty; now there is one of me in it.

lines.zh: 我从最深处往上数了三层。
lines.en: I counted three layers up from the deepest point.

lines.zh: 夜越深，我越像自己的样子。
lines.en: The deeper the night, the more I look like myself.

lines.zh: 火顺着树皮往上爬，我听见自己烧。
lines.en: Fire climbs my bark, and I hear myself burning.

lines.zh: 落地时我的枝散了一地。
lines.en: On landing my branches scatter across the floor.

lines.zh: 水灌进木头的孔里，我变重了。
lines.en: Water fills the pores of my wood, and I grow heavy.

lines.zh: 气浪把我吹得贴在石壁上。
lines.en: The blast slams me flat against the stone.

lines.zh: 箭插在年轮里，像一根新枝。
lines.en: The arrow sticks in a growth ring like a new twig.

lines.zh: 那股药味让我的根须全蜷起来。
lines.en: That potion scent curls every root hair of mine.

lines.zh: 我没有胃，可这身体在空耗。
lines.en: I have no stomach, yet this body burns itself away.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我全身的纹路都亮。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and all my grain lights up.

lines.zh: 虚空把我拆成一把干柴。
lines.en: The void takes me apart into a bundle of dry wood.
